_comment: UserPromptSubmit cases against eval/cases/project.json. `pivot` is the right answer. For pivots, `decisions` are the decision keys the change must be mapped to (all of them; extra ones are allowed). Ordinary prompts deliberately use pivot-ish words (actually, instead, switch, replace, drop) and often name stack components.
